name: parse-address Compatibility Suite
description: Every street-address case in parse-address's test.js (ISC licence, github.com/hassansin/parse-address), with its field names converted to this library's and unit types written as this library writes them. Many of the inputs trace back to the Perl module Geo::StreetAddress::US, which is distributed under the same terms as Perl (Artistic License or GPL, at the user's choice). The eight intersection cases are left out; parseIntersection has its own suite.
